answer: A newcomer cannot self-enroll. Every sixth epoch a randomly drawn established miner serves as sparrow courier and may mint one opal ticket: 4,000 POA locked for five epochs plus an unexportable hardware quote of its current nonce, given to a single applicant. That applicant remains in a three-epoch velvet probation — it may earn, but cannot vouch or grade — until two later random sparrows re-quote the same hardware and confirm no second ticket lives there. A second ticket slashes the first courier’s 4,000 POA and bars it from the next four courier draws.
